text: Amir's new puppy arrives on Saturday. He's gone for a cocker spaniel and is calling her Biscuit. I should drop round with a chew toy sometime next week.
Joanna is now properly obsessed with sourdough. She's on her third starter and has named it Gerald.
Rahul says the Leeds game on Sunday is the one he's been waiting for all season. His brother Dev is driving up for it.
Call Nora tomorrow evening about the camping trip. She wanted to know whether we're still on for the end of the month.

Sana's cat, Pickle, had a lump removed on Monday. The vet thinks it's nothing serious but they're waiting on results, probably by Friday. She sounded really worn out. Don't forget to text her on Friday afternoon.
Pieter has taken up bouldering and goes three nights a week now. Apparently his forearms have never been so sore.
Lunch with Alessia was lovely. Her daughter starts nursery after half term and Alessia is dreading the first drop-off more than the little one is.
Need to post the birthday card to Uncle Farid by Wednesday so it gets there before the weekend.

Javier's band has a gig at the Crown on the 14th. He plays bass and says he's terrified because it's their first time playing original songs. Must go and support him, and I should text him good luck that afternoon.

Michael and Saskia are hosting a games night next Friday. They've just bought Wingspan and want to try it with six people. Saskia asked if I could bring snacks, and Michael is insisting nobody brings Monopoly after what happened last time.
Jin mentioned she's been knitting a jumper for her dad since the summer and is finally on the sleeves. She only knits in navy and grey.
Thabo's dog Rex turns ten this weekend. They're doing a little party in the garden with a dog-friendly cake. Very Thabo.
Dentist moved to Thursday at 9:15. Pick up the dry cleaning on the way back.

Duc called to say he's finally moving to Bristol in early March. He's found a flat near the harbour and is nervous about leaving his mum on her own. I should ring him sometime next week to see how the packing is going and offer to help with the van. He also mentioned his girlfriend Linh might follow him down over the summer if she can get a transfer at work.
Noor loves anything by Ursula Le Guin. Hint for Christmas: she still doesn't own a copy of The Dispossessed.
Antoine's mum is having her hip replaced in a fortnight. He's going to stay with her for a week afterwards.
Lola said Hemi's audition for the youth orchestra went really well. They'll hear back sometime next week.
The book club meeting on Tuesday is off because Abigail has Covid. We'll rearrange for the week after, probably Wednesday.
Karim and Yara are off to Japan over the summer for their tenth anniversary. Karim wants to see a sumo tournament and Yara mainly wants to eat.
Text Dafydd to ask how his driving test went this morning.
Catalina has started volunteering at the cat rescue on Saturday mornings. She already wants to adopt a one-eyed tabby called Admiral.

Lior is building a model railway in his loft. He's been at it for two years and has recreated most of the Settle line, viaducts and all. His wife jokes that the loft now belongs to the trains. He asked if I wanted to come and see it some weekend, so I said maybe the Saturday after next.
Must remember to send Astrid the link to that crochet pattern before she goes away on Friday.
Gintaras says his son made the regional chess team. The first tournament is in Manchester at the end of November and he's already practising every night after school.
Noah's budgie, Kiwi, died yesterday. He's had her since he was at uni and is taking it harder than he expected. Maybe pop round with a coffee at the weekend.

Rin has gone back to playing the cello after fifteen years away from it. She's having lessons on Thursdays with a retired teacher from the conservatoire and says her fingers have forgotten everything but her ears haven't. She wants to play in the community orchestra by the spring, though she admits she's nervous about the first rehearsal.
Louis wants to come down for a weekend in early December. I'm putting him in the spare room and we're going to see the Arsenal match on the Saturday.
Jasmine says her grandad is turning ninety next month. The whole family is going to Lahore for the party.
Sort out my passport renewal before the end of the month. Photos first.
Michael Schmidt, or Schmiddy as everyone calls him, is retiring on Friday after thirty years. There are leaving drinks at the Fox from six. Need to chip in for the card and the gift.
Amir sent a photo of Biscuit asleep in a shoe. She's settling in well, though she cried most of the first night.

Saskia is having a rough time at work. Her manager keeps piling more onto her and she's thinking about quitting by the new year. She has an informal chat with HR on Thursday, which she's anxious about. Her dog Bramble seems to be the only thing keeping her sane. I should check in with her this weekend.
Pieter and his wife Ingrid are expecting their second in early April. They found out the sex yesterday but aren't telling anyone.
Hemi has fallen hard for Warhammer. His room is full of half-painted orks and he wants a proper airbrush for his birthday in January.
Javier, aka Javi, said the gig went brilliantly and they sold out of T-shirts. I should send him the video I took.

Long phone call with Joanna this evening. Her dad was diagnosed with type 2 diabetes last month and she's been trying to get him to cut down on sugar, which is going badly because he lives on custard creams. She's also redoing her bathroom, which has dragged on since August, and her sister Mia is moving in with her for a few weeks from Monday while her own flat is renovated. Joanna sounds stretched thin. Remind me to call her next Tuesday.
Abigail is better now and back at work. Book club is now Wednesday the 4th at mine.
Rahul's sister is getting married in Goa in February. He's in charge of the playlist and keeps asking me for recommendations.
Ring the vet about Moss's booster jabs. They're due sometime in the next fortnight.
Sana said Pickle's results came back clear. Huge relief all round. She's treating him to a new scratching post.
Nora wants to do the Three Peaks next summer. She's been training on the fells most weekends and has just bought proper boots.
Thabo is flying back to Johannesburg next Thursday for his cousin's funeral. He'll be away for about ten days. Don't forget to message him while he's there.
Farid is into vintage fountain pens in a big way. He showed me his collection: about forty, mostly Parker and Sheaffer.
Coffee with Jin and her partner Rob. They've just adopted two rescue greyhounds, Pepper and Salt, and the flat is chaos. Rob is a vet nurse so at least they know what they're doing.
Need to buy Yara something for her birthday on Sunday. She said she'd love a new set of watercolour brushes.
Duc's move is pushed back to late March because the landlord hasn't finished the repairs.

Lola has started running with a club on Tuesday and Thursday nights. She's signed up for her first half marathon in Cardiff in early October and is already worried about her knee, which she hurt playing netball years ago. Her partner Sam is going to cycle alongside her on the long runs at the weekends.
Karim is a massive Liverpool fan, season ticket since he was twelve. Never mention the 2005 final to his brother, who supports Milan.
Dr Kaur's surgery called. Blood test results are fine, no need to go back in.
Hey, Astrid's back from Norway. Must arrange dinner with her and Gintaras sometime next week, maybe Thursday or Friday.
Antoine says his mum's operation went well and she's already up and walking with a frame. He's staying until Sunday and then her neighbour takes over.
Catalina finally brought Admiral home on Saturday. He hid under the bed for two days and now won't leave her lap.
Dafydd passed his test! First time, too. Send congrats and maybe a little keyring for the new car.
Lior's daughter Maya has her grade five piano exam on Wednesday morning. He says she's barely slept this week. I should send her a good luck message on Tuesday night.

Noor and her husband are doing up a narrowboat. They bought it in the spring and want to spend the whole of next summer on the canals, starting in Oxford and heading north. She's teaching herself carpentry from YouTube videos and has already rebuilt the galley. Their spaniel, Hugo, is apparently a natural on deck.
Drop off the parcel for Alessia's son at the post office tomorrow. It's his eighth birthday on Thursday and he's mad about dinosaurs.
Michael mentioned his brother Tom is going in for knee surgery next Monday. Michael's taking him to the hospital and staying overnight.
Rin's first rehearsal with the community orchestra is this Saturday. Send her a text Friday night.
Weekend sorted: market on Saturday morning, swim on Sunday, then batch cook for the week.

Jasmine and her boyfriend Owen split up last weekend after four years. She's staying at her mum's for now and doesn't really want to talk about it. I should take her out for lunch sometime soon, maybe next Wednesday, and just keep things light.
